data.long_meaning: From the Basque word 'ximene' which means 'new moon'. This name is rich in symbolism, representing the cycle of life, renewal, and the power of the natural world. in_latin.long_meaning: Ximeno nomen originem habet a Graeco πλεσιμενο, quod significat fidem, fidelitatem, et sinceritatem. Ximeno nomen etiam significat hominem qui est fortis et robustus, qui non timet periculum, sed fidem suam semper servat.
